headword: {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A vehicle powered by an electric motor using energy stored in rechargeable batteries, as opposed to a conventional internal combustion engine vehicle.

examples.japanese: {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}えた→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I switched to an electric car.

examples.japanese: {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{充電|じゅうでん}→充電：04427_juuden⟧⟦スタンド→スタンド：00394_sutando⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Charging stations for electric vehicles are increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まり→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧、{電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{販売台数|はんばいだいすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{伸|の}びている→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: As environmental awareness has grown, electric vehicle sales have been increasing year by year.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧ (electricity) and ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧ (automobile). Often abbreviated as EV in both Japanese and English contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{充電|じゅうでん}→充電：04427_juuden⟧ (EV charging)
- {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧ (spread of electric vehicles)
- {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{替|か}える→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧ (to replace one's car with an EV)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}: battery electric vehicle (fully electric)
- ⟦ハイブリッド→ハイブリッド：11391_haiburiddo⟧⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧: hybrid vehicle (combined electric and gasoline)
- ⟦{燃料|ねんりょう}→燃料：13461_nenryou⟧⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧: fuel cell vehicle (hydrogen-powered)
